questions.stemHtml: A 58-year-old woman was diagnosed with Breast Cancer and was taken up for Surgery. The Following procedure was done at the beginning of surgery. What about this procedure is TRUE?

options.label: A
options.text: It can be done in the next sitting or as a follow-up procedure as well.

options.label: B
options.text: Breast-Conserving Surgeries do not require this investigation.

options.label: C
options.text: The Colored/Labelled Node is the Diseased Node.

options.label: D
options.text: The technique was developed to reduce the morbidity associated with axillary dissection.
